api.stop_outcome: Frozen dataclass with exact fields status and reason_code; status is an exact str requested|hold|confirmed; reason is a lowercase stable token of 1..64 characters. All implicit truth-value use raises TypeError.
api.gate: require_controller_start_allowed(results_dir) performs lstat on the three existing stop sentinels. Any existing marker, including dangling symlinks, refuses. Unverifiable I/O also refuses. Missing paths cause no mkdir, marker write, marker removal, process observation, signal, or lease change.
api.authority_limit: A StopOutcome, including a confirmed label, is not process-closure proof. This module exposes no is_confirmed permission helper, no adoption API, and no positive controller restart authority.

coverage: All three status labels are explicit frozen metadata.
Invalid status values and non-token/overlong reasons are refused.
No status label can be used as an implicit boolean.
An unmarked existing directory and a missing results directory are checked without modification or directory creation.
Each of the three existing sentinels refuses without interpreting its text, deleting it, or changing its inode/mtime/ctime.
A dangling sentinel symlink is present, not an absent target.
A controlled PermissionError during lstat is HOLD rather than absence; this is an explicit I/O fault injection, not a real host permission experiment.

findings_delivered_to_parent: Native handle_shutdown True includes stale-delivery no-op, so it is not controller-wide tree closure. Its exact ref/protocol and outer/inner TREE_CLOSED checks must remain unchanged.
Existing graceful shutdown can remove its PID file and write shutdown state while retaining held handles. Neither marker nor controller PID disappearance is an external stop ACK.
managed_run and cli_setup runnable checks already reject all three markers; they do not clear them. The actual automatic clear was in lifecycle.do_start and orchestrator._run_leased.

Legacy CLI --restart separately calls cli_setup.stop_running_instance, which is also used by upgrade/reinstall. Typed outcomes must not become implicit booleans or allow package mutation after unknown stop.
